title:
Food alert
22 October 2026
Waitrose recalls Waitrose Tuna Pate because of an incorrect use by date
Waitrose is recalling Waitrose Tuna Pate because of a labelling error, the use by date is incorrect.
summary: The product is labelled with an incorrect use by date of 17 December 2026 which makes it unsafe to eat after the correct use by date of 17 October 2026.
advice: If you have bought the above product, please do not consume it. Instead, return it to your local Waitrose store for a full refund. For further information, plea
